Whether TP53 loss is strictly necessary in human RAD51C carriers does not follow from the mouse, and the model uses conditional somatic deletion rather than the constitutional heterozygous state of a human carrier.

nodes.description: Breast cancer risk is moderate: a relative risk of 1.99 and a cumulative risk to age 80 of 21% in the segregation analysis, with the association stronger for oestrogen-receptor-negative and triple-negative disease than for breast cancer overall. nodes.description: RAD51C acts in two RAD51-paralog subcomplexes, BCDX2 with RAD51B, RAD51D and XRCC2, and CX3 with XRCC3. BCDX2 loads RAD51 onto single-stranded DNA and stabilizes the nucleoprotein filament, including on short single-stranded stretches and reversed replication forks, so RAD51C loss abolishes both homologous-recombination repair and the protection of stalled forks. Cancer-associated missense variants reduce RAD51 foci and leave forks unprotected, which is why fork protection is a second, separable consequence rather than a restatement of the repair defect.

nodes.description: High-grade serous tubo-ovarian carcinoma is the dominant manifestation, at a relative risk of 7.55 and a cumulative risk to age 80 of 11%. A separate meta-analysis of about 29,400 ovarian cancer cases against gnomAD controls gives an odds ratio of 5.59, so the two independent estimates agree on a high-risk gene. The tubo-ovarian relative risk rises with age to about 60 and then declines.

nodes.description: Homologous-recombination deficiency makes the tumour synthetically lethal to PARP inhibition. Platinum sensitivity is deliberately not claimed here: it is mechanistically expected and platinum is standard care in the associated cancers, but no source cached for this entry reports a platinum result in RAD51C-deficient disease specifically, and the node is named for what the evidence covers. The strongest RAD51C-specific clinical evidence is from promoter-methylated high-grade serous ovarian cancer in the phase-3 PAOLA-1 trial rather than from germline carriers, which matters when the result is read as support for treating a germline carrier.

nodes.description: Conditional epidermal and mammary Rad51c deletion produces mammary carcinoma in 63% of female mice only when combined with Trp53 inactivation, shortening latency from 11 to 6 months, and recapitulating the histopathology and genomic instability of human homologous-recombination-deficient breast cancer. Rad51c loss alone is insufficient.

The principal ovarian-cancer prevention for carriers, offered around menopause. It is the intervention the 11% cumulative tubo-ovarian risk justifies, and the reason this gene is managed differently from genes whose ovarian risk is lower. The 2025 ACMG clinical practice resource places RAD51C among the moderate-penetrance ovarian cancer predisposition genes for which carriers undergo the procedure.

nodes.description: Loss of the remaining wild-type RAD51C allele in a susceptible cell. The route that makes this gene distinctive is epigenetic: somatic promoter hypermethylation silences RAD51C and phenocopies germline loss, is strongly associated with mutational signature 3, and in a phase-3 ovarian-cancer trial identified 25 of 519 high-grade serous tumours that were homologous-recombination deficient and derived progression-free survival benefit from olaparib. The cell of origin for the tubo-ovarian tumours is the fallopian-tube fimbrial secretory epithelial cell, which acquires a TP53 mutation and forms a serous tubal intraepithelial carcinoma before seeding the ovary and peritoneum.

nodes.description: Removal of the p53 damage checkpoint permits survival of the genomically unstable clone. Epidermal and mammary Rad51c deletion produces mammary carcinoma in 63% of female mice only when combined with Trp53 inactivation, and shortens latency from 11 to 6 months; Rad51c loss alone is insufficient. Whether TP53 loss is strictly necessary in human RAD51C carriers is not settled by the mouse data or by the TP53-mutant status of the tubal precursor, so this is curated as a contributing node and not an obligate step.
